title: Mastermix Creation and Sample Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your CSV and select parameters.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: Upload your CSV file containing sample identifiers and select the protocol parameters in the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Generate and download the Python protocol file that will run on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 App before starting the run.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the deck map: sample tubes in slot 4, empty mastermix tubes in slot 5, and a 96‑well plate in slot 6.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Perform deck, tip‑rack, and pipette calibrations using the OT‑2 App before running the protocol.

steps.title: Create mastermix in deck slots 4‑5
steps.instruction: Prepare the mastermix by adding OptiMEM, DNA, and Viafect to the mastermix wells as defined by the CSV; the robot will pause for user confirmation before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Add 5.3 µL OptiMEM to each mastermix well (the last well may receive a larger volume if required by the CSV).
Add 4.4 µL DNA from the sample tubes in deck slot 4 to the corresponding mastermix wells in deck slot 5, following the CSV layout.
Add 1.3 µL Viafect to each mastermix well in deck slot 5.
Pause the robot and wait for the user to resume when ready.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix to destination plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of the completed mastermix from each well in deck slot 5 to the 96‑well plate in deck slot 6 in triplicate.

steps.title: Start run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the protocol.
